lobe.name: PandoMail
lobe.title: PandoMail LOBE
lobe.description: Local-UI request handlers for the PandoMail app (TdaMailClient, over /localcomm-ws): list/query email, resolve DIDs, and folder counts. Depends on Svrn7.SMTPEmail.0.8.0 for actual RFC 5322 email send/receive — this LOBE never talks to another TDA's /didcomm endpoint directly except to escalate a DID resolution miss to the parent TDA.
lobe.author: Michael Herman

protocols.title: List Emails Request
protocols.description: Query for stored email messages. Body: { limit?: int }. Replies with Get-PandoMails over WebSocket (envelope thid = this request's id).

protocols.title: Send Email (from PandoMail UI)
protocols.description: Accepted from local PandoMail UI via TdaMailClient. Body: { recipientDid, subject, bodyText }. Wraps as RFC 5322 via the Svrn7.SMTPEmail.0.8.0 LOBE's Enqueue-Email and delivers to recipient TDA.

protocols.title: Query TDA DID
protocols.description: Local UI request for this TDA's own DID. Replies with Reply-TdaDid over WebSocket (envelope thid = this request's id).

protocols.title: Get Email Body
protocols.description: Request for the full RFC 5322 body of a specific stored email message. Body: { messageDid: string }. Replies with Reply-EmailBody over WebSocket (envelope thid = this request's id).

protocols.title: Resolve DID Document (PandoMail)
protocols.description: Local UI request to resolve a DID Document. Body: { requestedDid: string }. Tries local registry; escalates to parent TDA via plaintext did-resolve-request on miss. Replies with Reply-DidDocument over WebSocket (envelope thid = this request's id).

protocols.title: List Sent Emails Request
protocols.description: Query for sent (outbound) email messages. Body: { limit?: int }. Replies with Get-PandoOutbox over WebSocket (envelope thid = this request's id).

protocols.title: List Dead Letters Request
protocols.description: Query for pending dead-letter records (failed outbound deliveries). Replies with Get-PandoDeadLetters over WebSocket (envelope thid = this request's id).

protocols.title: Query Folder Counts
protocols.description: Sent by PandoMail on connect to populate folder tree count annotations from existing data. No body required. Replies with Notify-FolderCounts over WebSocket.

The LOBE descriptor will become the MCP tool definition with no translation needed.
ai.summary: PandoMail-app-specific local-UI query surface: list/get email, resolve DIDs, folder counts. Actual email transport (send/receive between TDAs) is delegated to the Svrn7.SMTPEmail.0.8.0 LOBE.
useCases: PandoMail (WinForms) populating its Inbox/Sent/Dead Letters views over /localcomm-ws
Any other local-UI app that wants the same query surface over the shared TDA identity
compositionHints: Invoke-PandoMailSend forwards to Enqueue-Email (Svrn7.SMTPEmail.0.8.0) — requires that LOBE loaded in the same runspace, which it is by default (eager-loaded)
Invoke-PandoMailList / Invoke-PandoMailListDeadLetters call Get-Rfc5322Header (Svrn7.SMTPEmail.0.8.0) to parse stored RFC 5322 bodies
limitations: Local-UI only — all replies go over ws://local/localcomm-ws, never HTTP/2 POST.
Depends on Svrn7.SMTPEmail.0.8.0 being loaded in the same runspace (currently guaranteed by eager-loading, not by this descriptor's dependencies.lobes resolution).
